==Summary==

{{pov|[[Faile Bashere]]}}

It is almost noon and there is incessant thunder. [[Rolan]], [[Kinhuin]] and [[Jhoradin]] have cleared some of the stairway. Rolan helps them climb out one at a time, [[Faile Aybara|Faile]], then [[Maighdin]], [[Arrela Shiego|Arrela]], [[Lacile Aldorwin|Lacile]] and [[Alliandre]]. In the street there are a hundred or more of the people who swore fealty to Faile. [[Aravine Carnel|Aravine]] hands her a waterskin. She can see that the sky is clear and there is a [[One Power]] battle going on. Jhoradin helps Lacile and [[Aldin]] helps Arrela, though she does not like men. After drinking, Maighdin collapses due to the [[forkroot]] in the town water supply. Rolan says he will hide Faile until nightfall then take her to the forest to escape. They will have to abandon the supplies since the building collapsed but Rolan promises to supply what is needed. Aldin carries Maighdin as they walk through [[Malden]] followed by [[Theril]].

{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}

[[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]] is only a hundred paces from the gates of [[Malden]]. As he fights two [[Shaido]], [[Aram]] attacks him. Convinced by [[Masema]] that Perrin and [[Elyas]] are [[Shadowspawn]], Aram intends to kill Perrin to save Faile. Two Shaido arrows kill Aram while he is focused on Perrin. Turning a corner, he sees a horde of people in white led by three veiled Shaido ''[[algai'd'siswai]]''. One, who would have dwarfed [[Lamgwin]], pulls Faile. Perrin leaps at him and kills him with his hammer after Faile distracted him by calling Perrin's name. Faile and Lacile stab the other two in the back when they join in the attack. He takes Faile in his arms and is filled with her scent but she also smells guilty and ashamed, so Perrin thinks she was raped.{{verify}} Perrin tells them all to head north, the safest direction. He sends Theril to the fortress to tell [[Ban al'Seen]], [[Seonid]] and the others they can come out now.  

When Perrin discovers the woman he knew as Alyse didn't take Faile with her during her escape, Faile says she was actually [[Galina]] and figures she must be [[Black Ajah]]. Theril and those from the fortress return in a quarter hour. [[Selande]] and the other ''[[Cha Faile]]'' cluster around Faile. [[Rovair Kirklin]] goes to find [[Masuri]]. [[Tallanvor]] cradles Maighdin. [[Gaul]] goes to find [[Chiad]] and Elyas accompanies him. [[Furen]] and [[Teryl]] are with Seonid. She [[Healing|Heals]] Perrin, then Faile. She hears Faile mention Galina and after hearing the story, Seonid claims the right to try her in the White Tower. Perrin is irate but Faile reminds him how he required formal proof when [[Jon Thane]] accused Jac Coplin and Len Congar of stealing a cow. The battle is now over. [[Tylee]] rides up with [[Sevanna]] naked and tied across her horse. Most of Masema's men on the east ridge are dead but he escaped with roughly a hundred of his men. The ''[[sul'dam]]'' have already collared over two hundred Shaido [[Wise One|Wise Ones]]. Fortunately, Perrin's forces suffered only light casualties. Faile claims Sevanna's wealth to help restore the hundred thousand prisoners the Shaido took. Perrin introduces Faile and Alliandre to Tylee and reminds her that [[Ghealdan]] is under his protection. They need to get going before the other two Shaido septs arrive. Perrin thought he was making a deal with the Dark One but now Tylee asks him to call her by her first name and he says the same.

{{pov|[[Galina Casban]]}}

Galina retrieves her stash and packs Swift's saddlebags. Out in the woods, she is in the middle of changing clothes when [[Therava]] finds her and recovers the binder. With Therava are other Wise Ones, including [[Belinde]] and [[Modarra]], and several hundred Shaido. Therava says the Shaido will regroup and return to the [[Three-Fold Land]], never to leave again. They will rebuild even though it will take generations. Galina is broken; she will be Therava's little Lina for the rest of her life.
